name: CREMA-D
description: Acted emotional speech, comprising 7,442 clips performed by 91 actors. Access and use are subject to the CREMA-D release terms. No data is vendored here.
citation: Cao, H., Cooper, D. G., Keutmann, M. K., Gur, R. C., Nenkova, A., & Verma, R. (2014). CREMA-D: Crowd-sourced Emotional Multimodal Actors Dataset. IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing.
